issues.body: In `assert_datatype_property_restriction_refused`, both cfg-selected `matches!(result, ...)` expressions match `result` by value. Because `Result<Ontology, ExtractError>` is non-Copy, this consumes `result`; the following `assert!` then tries to format `result` with `{:?}`, causing E0382 (use of moved value). Consequently the extract integration test target cannot compile in either feature state, including the load-bearing `dl_datatypes` lane.
issues.fix_hint: Match by reference, e.g. `matches!(&result, Err(ExtractError::Unclassifiable(_)))` and the analogous `DataConstruct` arm, so `result` remains available for the diagnostic. Run the extract integration test with default features and with `--features dl_datatypes`.
issues.title: Feature-dependent refusal helper uses a moved Result

verdict.summary: The concrete-domain implementation is extensively documented and has meaningful end-to-end tests, but the feature-enabled extract test target does not compile because a helper consumes its Result before formatting it in the assertion failure message. This blocks the required feature-on test lane.
